context: a desktop app for managing recipes

_optional.model: override the engine profile's model — required for a local server, whose model id is whatever YOU serve
_optional.url: override the engine profile's base URL
_optional.think: ollama only: false | true | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'. Omitted = the model's own default. Off is much faster and measurably worse on placeholders.
_optional.profile: any other engine-profile field, overridden per project — batchSize, rateLimitMs, timeoutMs, maxOutputTokens, headers, extraBody
